display.purpose: Page titles and the holder's name on the cover band (1.5rem there).

title.purpose: Sub-heads inside a coupon and dashboard widget heads.

body.purpose: Reading text in Anuphan; helper text at 0.9rem in Ink Muted; paragraphs capped at 70 to 75ch.

label.purpose: Caption above a figure, table headers, form labels. 0.76 to 0.84rem, weight 600 to 700, sentence case.

figure.purpose: Filled-in numbers in coupon cells and totals. Carbon purple, tabular. Steps observed: 1.35, 1.55, 1.7, 1.9rem.

figure-lg.purpose: The one headline number of a panel (2.5 to 2.6rem).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Toast, chart tooltip, and controls floating over the driver's map. Never on coupons.

shadows.name: float-night
shadows.purpose: The same role on the admin night theme.

shadows.name: sheet-edge
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheet of the driver's navigation mode.

shadows.name: map-pin
shadows.purpose: Pins on map tiles, with a white ring.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Stamp landing, switch thumb, toast, navigation sheet, progress fill.

motion.name: stamp-land
motion.value: 0.45s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; from opacity 0, rotate(-12deg) scale(1.8)
motion.purpose: A stamp lands once when a stage changes or a request is sent. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background and colour transitions on buttons, dropzone, quick-login rows, switch.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: Driver navigation mode slides up; opacity only under reduced motion.

lines.name: frame
lines.purpose: Outer frame of every coupon and shared figure grid; rule under a tab head.

lines.name: hairline
lines.purpose: Inner rules between fields, rows and columns.

lines.name: perforation
lines.purpose: Tear line between stubs: QR stub, points stub, two-account ledger. Stage stubs use 2px dashed var(--line).

lines.name: stamp
lines.purpose: Stamp frame; 2px when small inside a table.

lines.name: shell-rule
lines.purpose: Green rule under the top bar and under the admin rail brand.

narrative.overview:
A pickup is a book of coupons: request, verify, weigh, deliver. Each coupon is a sheet of white stock lying on a cool grey-green table, framed in navy-black ink, with a tabbed head, hairline inner rules, and dashed perforations between its stubs. When a stage is done it is stamped; passed stages are struck through and stay where they are. Nothing floats, nothing is pill-shaped, nothing glows.

Three inks do the work. Carrier green is the service itself: the top rule of the shell, the cover band, the primary button, the slot flag, the "done" stamp. Carbon purple is the colour of anything that was filled in: every counted, weighed or priced figure, on every page. Navy-black ink draws the frames and fills the solid boxes that carry step numbers and bag codes. Red appears only where something was voided, went wrong, or cannot be recycled.

The admin back office is the same book on the night shift: dark stock, lighter rules, lavender figures. It is produced by redefining the tokens on the admin body, so every component is shared between the two themes.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled frames in ink (1.5px), hairline inner rules (1px), dashed perforations between stubs.
Tab heads sit flush against the top edge of a coupon; step numbers are solid ink boxes flush left.
Figures are Athiti 700 in carbon purple with tabular numerals; their small label sits above them.
Corners are almost square (3px and 2px). Coupons carry no shadow.
Stage stubs that stamp: one tilted stamp on the current stage, landing once when the stage changes.
All interface text is Thai, set in Athiti (heads, figures, buttons) and Anuphan (reading text).

rules.name: The Filled-In Figure Rule
rules.body: A number that was counted, weighed, priced or scored is carbon purple (lavender at night), Athiti 700, tabular. Purple is never used for a heading, a button or a decoration; if it is purple, somebody measured it. The one sanctioned second ink for a figure is carrier green dark, used to keep the second account apart in the two-account carbon ledger and on the one accented cell.

rules.name: The Stamp Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks a void, an error, a non-recyclable item or an unroutable stop. It is never a button fill, a brand accent or an emphasis colour.

rules.name: The Night Shift Rule
rules.body: Admin dark is a token swap on the body, nothing more. A new component is written once against the tokens and must read in both themes; solid ink boxes are the only elements with an explicit night override.

rules.name: The Label-Over-Figure Rule
rules.body: A figure cell is a small muted label above a large purple number, like a printed field with its entry written in. In markup the number comes first and the cell is reversed in layout, so assistive tech reads the value before its caption.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything numeric that can change or be compared (figures, table number columns, time slots, coordinates, deltas) uses tabular numerals, and table number columns are right-aligned.

rules.name: The Flat Stock Rule
rules.body: Nothing that lies on the table casts a shadow. If an element is not floating over a map or over the page, it gets a ruled frame instead.

rules.name: The Perforation Rule
rules.body: Dashes are for tear lines and unfilled or voided things. Do not use a dashed border as general decoration, and do not separate two stubs of one coupon with a solid gap or a margin.

dos: Do build every new surface as a coupon: 1.5px ink frame, 3px corners, a tab head flush to the top edge, no shadow.
Do set every measured number in Athiti 700, carbon purple, tabular, with its muted label above it.
Do put related figures in one shared frame with inner rules rather than in separate boxes.
Do use a 2px dashed line wherever two stubs of one coupon meet, and for anything unfilled or voided.
Do show completion with a stamp: one per coupon, tilted, in carrier green; red only for a void.
Do keep passed stages visible and struck through; a finished step is never removed.
Do write components against the tokens so they read on both day stock and the admin night shift.
Do keep the two carbon figures side by side and separate.
Do disable the stamp landing under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pill badges or soft drop shadows; this system replaced exactly that look.
Don't put a shadow on anything that is not floating over a map or the page.
Don't use carbon purple for headings, buttons or decoration.
Don't use red as an accent or a button colour.
Don't place a small label line above a heading; the role is already stated in the top bar and the cover band's second line.
Don't set figures in Anuphan or in proportional numerals.
Don't use field grey for reading text.
Don't add a second stamp to a coupon or replay the landing on refresh.
Don't draw material swatches as round dots or invent new material colours per page.
openItems: The pickup QR is a disclosure under a tear line on the request coupon, opened at full width on demand, not an always-visible stub.
Fonts are self-hosted in web/fonts (Athiti and Anuphan, SIL OFL) and precached by the service worker.
